description: Use when an agent needs an image from a text prompt. Input: prompt (max 1000 chars), optional steps (1-8, default 4). Output: JSON with a 1024x1024 JPEG (base64), steps, model, safety verdicts. Prompt screened by blocklist + Llama Guard 3, image by a vision check; sexual, minor, deepfake or gore requests refused 422, not charged. Not stored. Example: ?prompt=isometric%20illustration%20of%20a%20tiny%20robot%20cafe Price: $0.02 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

prompt.description: What to draw (English works best). Sexual content, minors in suggestive scenes, real-person deepfakes and gore are refused (422, not charged)

steps.description: Diffusion steps (default 4; more = finer detail, slower)

name: ai_image
title: Safe text-to-image: FLUX.1 schnell 1024x1024 JPEG with prompt and output safety checks
